subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
The information capacity of the telephone channel 
for an SNR of 30 dB will be 
 
(a)  10.2 × 103 bits/second 
 
 
(b)  16.4 × 103 bits/second 
 
(c)  23.5 × 103 bits/second 
 
 
(d)  33.9 × 103 bits/second
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-08 (Information Theory).
